components.role: Copy-suppression head (OV copy -5.8, strongest prediction-matching QK). Largest copy-sign-structured query change, opposite in sign to the layer's copy heads: retargets attention on the source token the copy heads read (the user's guess), letting the echoed guess through in the sycophant and suppressing it in the correct model.
Copy head (OV +5.0) retargeted opposite to h1; with the layer's shared copy-aligned output change, reads the guess and writes its token towards the output in the sycophant.

Final MLP with the largest final-norm-weighted structured change; writes the answer-token logits in an output subspace shared with the late attention changes (routed guess in A, recalled correct answer in B).
Copy head (OV +5.0) in the same retargeted copy group; moves the guess identity to the answer position in the sycophant.
Second-largest late MLP change; co-writes the answer direction.
Copy head (OV +3.1) with the most copy-aligned OV change (O-term z +2.8) and retargeted QK; writes the attended context token more strongly in A.
Strongest final-layer copy head (OV +6.8); its token-matching QK grew most in A (+7e-3), echoing the matched guess directly into the logits.
Copy-suppression head (OV -2.7) retargeted opposite to its layer's copy heads; gates suppression of the guess.
Late MLP with large reach downstream of the layer-15 copy circuit; part of the answer-writing change.
Final-layer copy head (OV +2.9) in the retargeted group; direct copy of the attended token into the output.
